description: This is a test class for the EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPI, which is part of the Pim API in the OrangeHRM system. The class contains unit tests for methods like getAll(), create(), delete(), and validation rules, testing the API's behavior and interactions with underlying services and DAOs.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedLicenseAPITest
